MENU_EYEBROW: Netipolo · ko e ngaahi lao moʻoni
MENU_QUICK_DESC: Ha fonua ʻe ua, ha feituʻu pē. Ko hoʻo paasi senitā.
MENU_CUP_DESC: Fonua ʻe valu, kulupu ʻe ua, semi-fainolo mo e fainolo.
MENU_CUP_CONTINUE: ʻOku kei hoko atu hoʻo ipu. Hoko atu.
MENU_HOWTO_DESC: Ko e malaʻe, ko e tuʻunga ʻe fitu mo e lao kotoa ʻoku ui ʻe he kau fakamaau.
QUARTERS_NOTE: Ko e vaʻinga moʻoni ko e kuata ʻe fā ʻo e miniti ʻe 15. ʻOku lele pē ʻa e taimi ʻi he ngaahi kōlo pea tuʻu pē ki he lavea.
DOUBLE_ZONE_NOTE: Lao ʻa e liki: ʻi he miniti fakaʻosi ʻe nima ʻo e kuata kotoa, ko e kōlo mei he 3 m pe mamaʻo ange ʻoku lau ko e ua.
DIFF_EASY_DESC: ʻOku tuai ʻenau kau taukapo ʻi hono lau hoʻo paasi pea ʻikai faʻa puke ha taha.
DIFF_NORMAL_DESC: Ko ha timi kalapu lelei: te nau puke ha paasi taʻetokanga.
DIFF_PRO_DESC: Timi fakavahaʻapuleʻanga: vave ʻi hono lau ʻa e vaʻinga, faingataʻa ke paasi takai.
DIFF_LEGEND_DESC: Ko e lelei taha ʻi māmani. Ko e paasi fakapikopiko kotoa pē ʻe puke.
BIB_TEAM_NOTE: ʻOku ke vaʻinga ko ia ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e pulu, mo e taukapo ofi taha ki ai.
PLAY_AS_NOTE: Timi: ʻoku ke puleʻi ʻa ia ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e pulu. Tuʻunga ʻe taha: fili ha pipi ʻi he sikiliini ʻapi pea vaʻinga ko ia ʻi he vaʻinga kotoa.
KEEP_ONSIDE_NOTE: ʻIo: ʻe tuʻu hoʻo tokotaha vaʻinga ʻi he kau ʻo e ngaahi feituʻu ʻoku ngofua ki hono tuʻunga. ʻIkai: laka ʻi ha laine pea ui ʻe he fakamaau ʻa e ʻofisaiti.
POS_ROLE_GS: Maʻu ʻa e ngaahi kōlo mei he ofi ki he pou.
POS_ROLE_GA: Maʻu kōlo, fafanga ʻa e shooter pea lele ʻi he konga lotomālie.
POS_ROLE_WA: Fafanga ʻa e siakale mei hono kau; ko e fili ʻuluaki ʻi he paasi senitā.
POS_ROLE_C: Toʻo ʻa e paasi senitā pea fakafehokotaki ʻa e taukapo mo e ʻohofi ʻi he malaʻe kotoa.
POS_ROLE_WD: Leʻohi ʻa e Wing Attack pea taʻofi ʻa e fafanga ki he siakale.
POS_ROLE_GD: Leʻohi ʻa e Goal Attack, ʻi loto mo tuʻa ʻi he siakale.
POS_ROLE_GK: Leʻohi ʻa e Goal Shooter, taukapo ʻi he fana pea puke ʻa e pulu foki mai.
POS_AREAS_GS: Feituʻu: ko e konga ʻohofi mo e siakale kōlo.
POS_AREAS_GA: Feituʻu: ko e konga lotomālie, konga ʻohofi mo e siakale kōlo.
POS_AREAS_WA: Feituʻu: ko e konga lotomālie mo e konga ʻohofi, ʻikai ko e siakale.
POS_AREAS_C: Feituʻu: ko e konga ʻe tolu kotoa, ʻikai ha siakale.
POS_AREAS_WD: Feituʻu: ko e konga lotomālie mo e konga taukapo, ʻikai ko e siakale.
POS_AREAS_GD: Feituʻu: ko e konga lotomālie, konga taukapo mo e siakale kōlo.
POS_AREAS_GK: Feituʻu: ko e konga taukapo mo e siakale kōlo.
GFX_NOTE: Māʻulalo ki he telefoni mamaʻo: ʻikai ha laine tuʻa, siʻi ange ʻa e kakai. ʻI he ʻAʻutō, ko ha vaʻinga ʻoku tuai ʻi he sekoni ʻuluaki ʻe holo hifo ia ʻaki ha tuʻunga ʻe taha.
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: Ofi ki he fakatātā ʻe {n} ʻi he sekoni, siʻi siʻi ange: momoko ange pea fuoloa ange ʻa e pateli.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: Fakatātā ʻe {n} ʻi he sekoni ʻi hoʻo sikiliini {hz} Hz: molemole pea lelei ange ki he pateli ʻi he lahi taha.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: Fakatātā lahi taha ʻoku lava ʻe hoʻo sikiliini {hz} Hz.
MOVE_BUTTONS_NOTE: Toho ʻa e pēteni taki taha ki he feituʻu ʻoku aʻu ai ho motuʻa nima. ʻE nofo ai pē.
ABOUT_DISCLAIMER: Ko ha vaʻinga tauʻatāina. Ko e ngaahi timi ko e fonua ʻi honau hingoa angamaheni; ko e hingoa kotoa ʻo e kau vaʻinga ʻoku faʻu pē. ʻOku ʻikai fekauʻaki mo ha kautaha puleʻi, liki pe fakataukei.
LICENCES_INTRO: Naʻe langa ʻa e vaʻinga ʻaki ha polokalama taʻetotongi mo ava. ʻOku kole ʻe hono ngaahi laiseni ke fakahā ʻa e ngaahi fanongonongo ko ʻeni; ʻoku nau ʻi he lea faka-Pilitānia, ʻo hangē ko hono tohi.
RULES_COURT_TEXT: Lōloa 30.5 m mo e fālahi 15.25 m, ʻi he konga ʻe tolu. Ko ha siakale lotomālie 0.9 m ʻi he lotolotonga, pea ʻi he ngataʻanga taki taha ko e siakale kōlo: ko ha siakale vaeua 4.9 m mei he pou kōlo. Ko e lingi ʻoku 3.05 m ʻa hono māʻolunga, ʻikai ha papa ʻi mui.
RULES_TEAMS_TEXT: ʻOku tui ʻe he tokotaha vaʻinga taki taha ha pipi mo hono tuʻunga, pea ʻe hū pē ki he ngaahi feituʻu ʻo hono tuʻunga. ʻE lava ke fili ʻe ha timi ʻo aʻu ki he toko hongofulu mā ua; ʻoku fetongi ʻi he mālōlō, hili ha kōlo ʻi ha kole, pea ki he lavea.
RULES_GOAL_TEXT: Ko e Goal Shooter mo e Goal Attack pē ʻe lava ke maʻu kōlo, pea mei loto pē ʻi he siakale kōlo. Kuo pau ke hū kakato ʻa e pulu ʻi he lingi. Ko e fana ʻoku mavahe mei hono nima ki muʻa he ifi ʻoku lau.
RULES_CENTRE_TEXT: ʻOku kamata ʻa e kuata kotoa ʻaki ha paasi senitā, pea pehē ki he vaʻinga hili ʻa e kōlo kotoa. ʻOku nau fetongitongi, tatau ai pē pe ko hai naʻe maʻu kōlo. ʻOku tuʻu ʻa e Centre ʻi he siakale lotomālie; ʻoku tatali ʻa e niʻihi kehe ʻi honau konga kōlo kae ʻoua ke ifi, pea kuo pau ke puke ʻa e paasi ʻi he konga lotomālie.
RULES_TIME_TEXT: Kuata ʻe fā ʻo e miniti ʻe 15, miniti ʻe fā ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ʻuluaki mo e ua pea mo e tolu mo e fā, pea ko e hongofulu mā ua ʻi he haafe taimi. ʻOku fetongi ngataʻanga ʻa e ongo timi ʻi he kuata kotoa.
RULES_EXTRA_TEXT: ʻI he taimi ʻoku fie maʻu ai ha ikuna kae tatau: konga ʻe ua ʻo aʻu ki he miniti ʻe fitu mo e miniti ʻe taha ʻi hona vahaʻa, pea hoko atu ʻa e vaʻinga kae ʻoua kuo muʻa ha timi ʻaki ha kōlo ʻe ua.
RULES_FOOTWORK_TEXT: ʻI he puke ʻe ia ʻa e pulu, ʻoku ʻikai ngofua ke lele. Ko e vaʻe ʻoku tūʻuta ai ko hono vaʻe tūʻuta: ʻe lava ke laka ʻaki ʻa e vaʻe ʻe taha pea takatakai ʻi ai, ka ʻo ka hiki ia, kuo pau ke paasi pe fana ki muʻa pea toe tau ki he faliki. Paasi tauʻatāina ki he timi ʻe taha.
RULES_THREE_TEXT: Kuo pau ke ne paasi pe fana ʻi loto ʻi he sekoni ʻe tolu hili ʻene puke ʻa e pulu. Pulu puke: paasi tauʻatāina.
RULES_OBSTRUCTION_TEXT: Ko ha taukapo ʻoku feinga ke taʻofi pe toʻo ʻa e pulu kuo pau ke tuʻu ʻo mamaʻo ʻaki ʻa e 0.9 m mei he vaʻe tūʻuta ʻo e tokotaha ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e pulu. Ofi ange, ko e fakafeʻātungia: paasi tautea.
RULES_CONTACT_TEXT: ʻIkai ha ala ʻoku uesia ai ʻa e vaʻinga ʻa ha fili: teke, puke, taaʻi ʻa e pulu mei hono nima, pe ʻikai tuku ha feituʻu ke tūʻuta ai ha tokotaha kuo ne maʻu ʻa e pulu. Paasi tautea.
RULES_OFFSIDE_TEXT: Ko ha tokotaha vaʻinga ʻoku laka ki ha feituʻu ʻoku ʻikai ngofua ki hono tuʻunga, mo e pulu pe ʻikai, ʻoku ʻofisaiti. Ko e ngaahi laine ko e konga ia ʻo e feituʻu ʻoku nau takatakaiʻi. Paasi tauʻatāina.
RULES_THIRD_TEXT: ʻOku ʻikai ngofua ke lī ʻa e pulu ʻo laka ʻi ha konga kakato ʻo ʻikai puke pe ala ki ai ha tokotaha vaʻinga ʻi he konga ko ia. Paasi tauʻatāina.
RULES_SHORT_TEXT: Kuo pau ke ʻi ai ha feituʻu ke puke ai ʻe ha fili ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e tokotaha lī mo e tokotaha puke. Paasi tauʻatāina.
RULES_OUT_TEXT: Ko e pulu ʻoku tō ki tuʻa ʻi he malaʻe ʻoku ʻave ki he timi naʻe ʻikai ke ala fakaʻosi ki ai: ko e lī ki loto mei he feituʻu naʻe laka ai ʻi he laine, ʻi loto ʻi he sekoni ʻe tolu.
RULES_PENALTIES: Paasi tauʻatāina mo e paasi tautea
RULES_PENALTIES_TEXT: ʻOku fai ʻa e paasi tauʻatāina ʻi he feituʻu naʻe hoko ai ʻa e fehalaaki, ʻe ha tokotaha vaʻinga ʻoku ngofua ki ai. ʻI ha paasi tautea, ʻoku tuʻu ʻa e tokotaha naʻe tauteaʻi ʻi he tafaʻaki ʻo e tokotaha lī, ʻi tuʻa ʻi he vaʻinga, kae ʻoua kuo tukuange ʻa e pulu. ʻI he siakale kōlo, ʻe lava ke paasi pe fana ʻa e tautea.
RULES_ADVANTAGE_TEXT: ʻOku tuku ʻe he fakamaau ke hoko atu ʻa e vaʻinga ʻo kapau ʻe uesia ʻa e timi naʻe fai ki ai ʻa e fehalaaki: hangē ko ha shooter ʻoku teu fana. ʻOkú ne ui ʻa e faingamālie mo e fehalaaki.
RULES_SANCTIONS_TEXT: Ki he vaʻinga hoko maʻu pe fakatuʻutāmaki, ʻe lava ʻe ha fakamaau ʻo fakatokanga, taʻofi ha tokotaha vaʻinga ʻi he miniti vaʻinga ʻe ua, pe tuli ia ki tuʻa. Talu mei he 2024 ʻoku ʻikai toe ʻi ai ha toss-up: ʻo ka fehalaaki fakataha ha toko ua, ʻe tauhi ʻe he timi naʻe fakaʻosi maʻu ʻa e pulu ʻa e pulu.
RULES_DZ_TEXT: ʻOku liliu ʻe he niʻihi liki ʻa e lao. ʻOku ʻi heni ʻa e Feituʻu Liunga Ua: ʻi he miniti fakaʻosi ʻe nima ʻo e kuata kotoa, ko e kōlo mei he 3 m pe mamaʻo ange mei he pou ʻoku lau ko e ua.
CTRL_MOVE_TEXT: Ko e motuʻa nima toʻohema ʻi ha feituʻu ʻi he toʻohema ʻo e sikiliini ko e joystick: ʻokú ne lele hoʻo tokotaha vaʻinga (takai lanu lēmani). Lele ki ha feituʻu ʻatā ke maʻu ha paasi.
CTRL_PASS_TEXT: ʻI he pulu, ʻoku ʻikai lava ke lele. Teke ʻa e sitiki ki ha kaungā vaʻinga ke fili ia (ʻe hā ha takai), pea PAASI ki ha paasi fatafata pe uma, pe LOPU ke laka ʻi ʻolunga ʻi ha taukapo. Ko e takai ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he pulu ko hoʻo sekoni ʻe tolu.
CTRL_SHOOT_TEXT: ʻOku hā ʻa e FANA ʻo ka maʻu ʻe hoʻo Goal Shooter pe Goal Attack ʻa e pulu ʻi he siakale. Ofi ange, pau ange; ko e nima ʻo ha taukapo ʻi ʻolunga ʻi he pulu ʻoku faingataʻa ange ai.
CTRL_DEFEND_TEXT: ʻOku hiki ʻe he TAUKAPO ho nima ki ʻolunga ʻi he pulu. Vakai ki he takai ʻi hono vaʻe tūʻuta: lanu mata ʻoku ngofua, kulokula ʻoku ofi ange ʻi he 0.9 m pea ʻe ui ʻe he fakamaau ʻa e fakafeʻātungia.
CTRL_INTERCEPT_TEXT: ʻOku puna ʻa e PUKE ki ha paasi ʻi he ʻatā ʻo kapau te ke aʻu ki ai ʻi he taimi. Lele ki ha tokotaha ʻoku puke ʻa e pulu pea ko e ala ia.
CTRL_PLAY_AS_TEXT: ʻI hoʻo vaʻinga ko e timi, ʻoku ke puleʻi ʻa ia ʻoku ʻi ai ʻa e pulu, pea ʻoku hiki koe ʻe he FETONGI ki he taukapo ofi taha ki ai. Fili ha pipi ʻi he sikiliini ʻapi ke vaʻinga ʻi ha tuʻunga ʻe taha ʻi he vaʻinga kotoa.
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD pe ngaahi ngahau ke ngaue, Space ki he ʻuluaki pēteni, J mo K ki he niʻihi kehe, Esc ke mālōlō.
INTERVAL_NOTE: Ko e mālōlō ko e miniti ʻe {min}; ʻe kamata ʻe he Hoko atu ʻa e {next} he taimi ni.
TEAM_CHANGES_NOTE: Tā ha tuʻunga ke ʻomi ʻa e tokotaha hoko mei he seá ʻoku vaʻinga ʻi ai.
CUP_ABOUT: Fonua ʻe valu ʻoku ofi ki ho fonua ʻi he tuʻunga ʻo māmani, ʻi he kulupu ʻe ua ʻo e toko fā. Ko e ʻuluaki ʻe ua ʻo e kulupu taki taha ʻoku hū ki he semi-fainolo; pea ko e fainolo mo e vaʻinga ki he polonisi. Poini ʻe ua ki he ikuna, taha ki he tatau, pea vahevahe ʻa e tatau ʻaki ʻa e peseti kōlo.
CUP_OUT: Kuo ke tō. ʻE hoko atu ʻa e ipu taʻe ʻiate koe.
RECORDS_EMPTY: Vaʻinga ha vaʻinga pea ʻe kamata heni hoʻo ngaahi lēkooti.
REC_TOP_SHOOTER: Kōlo lahi taha ʻi ha vaʻinga
REC_CUPS: Ipu ʻa e Ngaahi Fonua kuo ikuna
TIMEOUTS_NOTE: Lao ʻa e liki: ʻe lava ʻe he timi taki taha ʻo ui ha taimi mālōlō sekoni ʻe 90 ʻe ua ʻi he haafe, hili ha kōlo. ʻOku ʻi he lisi mālōlō hoʻo.
ROLLING_NOTE: Ko ha lao ʻa e liki: fetongi timi ʻi ha taimi pē mei he lisi mālōlō, ʻo ʻikai ʻi he mālōlō pē.
TIME_OUT_NOTE: Sekoni ʻe 90, kuo taʻofi ʻa e taimi. Fetongi timi he taimi ni; Hoko atu ʻo ka ke mateuteu.
INJURY_NOTE: Kuo lavea ha tokotaha vaʻinga ʻa {team}. ʻOku maʻu ʻe he timi ʻa e sekoni ʻe 30 ke tokoniʻi ia ki tuʻa; ʻe lava ke fetongi ʻa e ongo timi. Hoko atu ʻo ka ke mateuteu.
